**Repair release. The cathedral and the Templar armory.**

## The initiation no longer dies with Esteban

The Knights Templar initiation sends you to Sir Esteban at the Crossroads. If he dies before
you finish his tasks -- a goblin patrol, or the Horde's contract on him -- the quest fails,
and until now that was the end of the Templars for that character. Lord Javier had the line
for exactly this -- *"This news weighs heavy on my heart... you must seek out Sir Auric for the
next part of your initiation"* -- and nothing led to it. Now *"Sir Esteban is dead"* is on his
greetings when it is true, and the initiation goes on. Works on any save.

## They remember being attacked

Attack Sir Auric in the armory, or Lord Javier in the cathedral, and you wake in the
Inquisition's cell. Walk back in and, until now, the map reset itself and they greeted you as
if nothing had happened. Auric's voiced *"Save your belligerence for the creatures of the
wilderness"* and Javier's *"If you blaspheme this cathedral again, you will regret it"* both
play now, once, on your return -- and the cathedral posts the extra guard beside Javier that
its map had built for that and never switched on. He stays. These need a character who has
not entered the armory or the cathedral.

## Under the hood

A new build check: every list in a map must hold exactly as many items as it says. It caught
a mistake of mine in this very release before it shipped.

## Installing

Download, unzip, run `Mod Manager.bat`. It installs over any earlier release.
